Moonlight Slivers are a type of Celestial creature that can be encountered in Act Three as part of the quest Find the Nightsong.

Involvement

If the party chooses to help  Lorroakan capture  Dame Aylin then she will summon four Moonlight Slivers to aid her. They cast  Silvered Bulwark on her and are dangerous enemies for an unprepared party.

Damage: 12~144
12d12⁠Radiant
Strike back at an attacker with holy righteousness. It can use Selûne's Ire again after its next turn.
 DEX Save
 Range: 18 m (60 ft)
 Silvered Bulwark ()

Form an impenetrable barrier of moonlight around a target that follows them and makes all creatures within Immune to damage.

 Range: 18 m (60 ft)

Immunities

  •  Charmed conditions, such as  Charmed and  Dominated
  •  Frightened conditions, such as  Frightened and  Phantasmal Killer

Notes

  • Moonlight Silvers can target only elementals with  Banishing Smite (Melee) and bypass the 50 HP threshold associated with the spell.
  • While Moonlight Silvers are winged creatures, they lack the ability to  Fly and are not immune to fall damage.
